title: Skill and create races
acceptance_criteria: A CRLF skill copy counts as the bundle file it equals and is refreshed with CRLF line breaks, and a file skill update cannot write is refused naming it, never assertion text (#373). Parallel skill update and init runs each succeed, or refuse only as a run on its own would (#386). Plain skill status and update skip a host folder that cannot be inspected, report it relative to the project and update the rest, exiting 0, while --host for it refuses (#403). chough doctor reports an untracked record under .chough/ that its reader refuses as unreadable, with the file and the reason (#408).

answers.constraints: The issues set the scope: #373 (lead-F5, F6), #386 (s3-F2, F7) as "the same create-new race", #403 and #408, with fable-lead adding uncommitted unreadable records beside #408. CRLF matching changes REQ-cli-016's criterion that newline changes stay edited, so it is a choice for Leif. Based on main; it modifies no requirement #407, D1, L2 or #311 modifies, and #408 is a new requirement so it does not wait on D1. No new dependency. Failing tests first.
